cardEffects: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [D-Reaper] trait and 1 [ADR-02 Searcher] among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.

name: ADR-03 Pendulum Feet
nameJapanese: ADR-03 = ペンデュラムフィート

references.text: Official JP Q&A for EX2-047 (2024/09/20, translated by DeepL)

rulings.answer: No. Cards that don't have levels can't be digivolved from, and you can't digivolve into this card. (Other than through special digivolutions.)
rulings.question: This card doesn't have a level. Can I still digivolve into it and into other cards?

rulings.answer: Yes, as long as either a card with [D-Reaper] in its traits or [ADR-02 Searcher] is among the cards revealed, you can add it to your hand.
rulings.question: This card’s effect reveals 4 cards. If the cards revealed only include either a card with [D-Reaper] in its traits or [ADR-02 Searcher], can I still add a card to my hand?

rulings.answer: No. This card's effect reads “Add 1 card [...] among them to your hand,” so you must add both a card with [D-Reaper] in its traits and [ADR-02 Searcher] to your hand.
rulings.question: This card's effect reveals 4 cards. If both a card with [D-Reaper] in its traits and [ADR-02 Searcher] are among the cards revealed, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining card at the bottom of my deck?

rulings.answer: Yes, I add to my hand whenever possible.
rulings.question: Does the effect of this card add the target card to the hand whenever possible if it is among the cards revealed from the deck?
